name: What types of fixtures does Frasheski Construction help coordinate?

mainEntity.name: What types of fixtures does Frasheski Construction help coordinate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction assists with the coordination of a wide range of fixtures, including plumbing fixtures (sinks, faucets, toilets, tubs), lighting fixtures (recessed, pendant, sconce), electrical outlets and switches, and various types of cabinetry hardware. We also coordinate with appliance deliveries and built-in elements to ensure all components fit and function as intended. Our coordination aims to integrate all these elements into a cohesive and functional space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction coordinates various fixtures, such as plumbing, lighting, electrical, cabinetry, and appliances, ensuring they fit and function.
